name: Santa Visits at the Miller Park Branch Library
venue: Miller Park Branch, Upper Arlington Public Library
when_note: Thursday, December 3, six registered time slots from 4 to 7 PM
ages: Babies, toddlers, preschool, school age and families
paras: The Upper Arlington Public Library holds its Home for the Holidays Santa visits at the Miller Park Branch, 1901 Arlington Ave, on Thursday, December 3, 2026. Families register for a 30 minute slot to visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus, with six slots running from 4 to 7 PM.
Each slot includes take-home crafts and cookies. The library lists the visits for babies, toddlers, preschoolers, school age children and families, and registration is required for each time slot.
tip: Register for a time slot first, since each 30 minute visit is booked separately.
